-- FLOWERS V18 - SUCCESSFUL LAUNCH VERSION
local p = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer

local function say(msg)
    pcall(function()
        local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage'):FindFirstChild('DefaultChatSystemChatEvents')
        if rs then rs.SayMessageRequest:FireServer(';'..msg, 'All') end
        local tcs = game:GetService('TextChatService')
        if tcs.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
            local tc = tcs.TextChannels:FindFirstChild('RBXGeneral')
            if tc then tc:SendAsync(';'..msg) end
        end
    end)
end
